title: The Tiny Practice
concept: A dollhouse cutaway of the entire practice rendered as a premium scale miniature, camera gliding room to room in one continuous move. Reception, the kid's corner, an operatory mid-appointment, sterilization — tiny people going about an ordinary day. Reads as studio-made rather than generated, carries zero uncanny-valley risk, and it actually shows the whole practice, which is the job a dental ad has to do. Swap the sign and it resells to any dental client.

audio.music: Light plucked strings with a music-box quality, curious and unhurried. Builds slightly at the pull-back.
audio.sfx: Miniature-scale foley: a tiny door latch, a small chair swivel, a soft paper shuffle. Everything one size too small, which is the joke.

frames.story: The whole practice as a miniature building on a table, morning light raking across it.
frames.image_prompt: A highly detailed architectural scale model of a small single-storey suburban dental practice, photographed as a tabletop miniature with tilt-shift shallow focus. Warm morning sidelight rakes across a tiny brick facade, miniature shrubs, a small parking sign, a hand-painted shopfront sign reading SMILE FAMILY DENTAL. Visible model-making craft: slightly soft paint edges, real material texture, a faint seam in the baseboard. Shot on a macro lens at f4 with soft studio lighting, deep clean background falling to grey. Vertical composition, no people.
frames.motion_prompt: Slow push in toward the front door, tilt-shift blur band drifting with the move. No cuts. Audio: music box opens, distant tiny ambience.

frames.story: Camera glides through the front wall, revealing the cutaway interior.
frames.image_prompt: A cutaway dollhouse view of a miniature dental practice with the front wall removed, showing two rooms side by side in cross-section like an architectural model. Miniature furniture, tiny framed pictures, a small reception desk, warm interior lamps glowing at model scale. Tilt-shift macro photography of a physical scale model, soft studio lighting from above, visible craft texture in the materials. Vertical composition, no people.
frames.motion_prompt: Continuous glide forward through the missing wall into the interior, parallax between the room layers. Strictly no cut. Audio: tiny door latch.

frames.story: Reception. A tiny figure checks in. Plants, a warm lamp, an ordinary morning.
frames.image_prompt: Miniature model reception area of a dental practice in cutaway, with a small painted figurine standing at a tiny reception desk and a second figurine seated behind it. Miniature potted plants, a working-looking desk lamp casting warm light, a minute stack of paper. Tilt-shift macro photograph of a physical scale model, shallow focus falling off behind, soft warm studio lighting. Vertical composition.
frames.motion_prompt: Slow lateral drift right across the reception desk, focus racking gently from the figurine to the lamp. Audio: soft paper shuffle.

frames.story: The kid's corner: toy box, small chair, a dropped crayon on the floor.
frames.image_prompt: A miniature children's waiting corner inside a dollhouse-scale dental practice: a tiny toy box with the lid ajar, two small child-sized chairs, a rug, and a single dropped crayon lying on the miniature floor. Warm light from a small window, tilt-shift macro photograph of a physical scale model, shallow depth of field, visible material texture and slight handmade imperfection. Vertical composition, no people.
frames.motion_prompt: Gentle drift downward toward the dropped crayon, which stays sharp as the room softens. Audio: music box motif repeats one note higher.

frames.story: An operatory mid-appointment. Calm, unhurried, entirely ordinary.
frames.image_prompt: A miniature dental operatory in cutaway cross-section: a tiny dental chair reclined, a small overhead light on its articulated arm, a figurine in scrubs seated beside a patient figurine, miniature cabinets along the back wall. Everything at model scale with visible craft texture. Tilt-shift macro photograph of a physical scale model, cool daylight mixed with a warm lamp, shallow focus. Vertical composition.
frames.motion_prompt: Slow arc around the chair, the overhead lamp catching a highlight as the camera passes. Audio: small chair swivel, music warms.

frames.story: Pull back — the whole cutaway practice revealed at once, every room alive.
frames.image_prompt: Wide view of a complete cutaway dollhouse model of a dental practice, all four rooms visible at once in cross-section: reception, children's corner, operatory, and a small sterilization room, each lit with its own tiny warm lamp. Miniature figurines placed throughout. Photographed as a physical scale model on a neutral surface, tilt-shift macro, soft even studio lighting, deep grey background. Vertical composition.
frames.motion_prompt: Smooth continuous pull back and slight rise, the whole model settling into frame. Audio: music resolves, all tiny ambience blends.

frames.image_prompt: Minimal end card on a soft warm grey background with subtle paper texture. Centered text in an elegant light-weight serif reading exactly: "A whole practice. One appointment at a time." Below it, small and widely letter-spaced in clean sans serif: SMILE FAMILY DENTAL CARE — UNION, NJ. Generous margins, nothing else in frame. Vertical composition.
frames.motion_prompt: Type fades up, background texture breathes once. Audio: final music-box note, silence.
